# Notifyd's communications diary

This is a list of all the anouncements our team has done for each one of the milestones we have reached and explaining some of the techniques and practices we use on the team.

- May 21st 2021 - [Darkship stories: distributed science experiments with splunk][1] by @latentflip
- Jun 11th 2021 - [Staff ship: notifyd a new notifications service][2] by @latentflip
- Jul 13th 2021 - [Staff ship: Push notifications for @mentions on discussions][3] by @franciscoj
- Sep 27th 2021 - [Notifyd is open for business!][4] by @jezcommits
- Oct 18th 2021 - [Notifyd: no longer experimental][5] by @franciscoj
- Jan 28th 2022 - [First version of label subscriptions is released][6] by @almaleksia
- Feb 10th 2022 - [Staff Ship: Receive notifications for label subscriptions 🚀][7] by @jezcommits
- Feb 28th 2022 - [New email appearance for label subscriptions 💌][8] by @jezcommits
- Mar 4th 2022 - [If you think it is not broken it means you have not used it enough][9] by @franciscoj
- Mar 11th 2022 - [Staff Ship: More events for label subscriptions][10] by @geramirez
- Mar 17th 2022 - [If you think it is not broken: Take 2][11] by @franciscoj
- July 9th 2022 - [Newsies Past and Present][12] by @franciscoj
